Parse one annotated text for REFI export

Source: R/export.R
refi_parse_text.Rd

Annotates a single XML fragment with anno_offsets(), extracts the coded segments with anno_ranges(), and returns the plain text together with the codings. Elements with a missing or empty code and empty (zero-width) elements are dropped with a warning.

Usage

refi_parse_text(x, tagname = "anno", code_attr = "value", label = NULL)

Arguments

x

A single character value with inline XML annotations, or NA (treated as an empty text).

tagname

Character vector of annotation element names.

code_attr

Name of the attribute holding the code name.

label

Optional label (e.g. row and document name) used to prefix error and warning messages.

Value

A list with elements text (plain text, character) and codings (data frame with columns code, start, end; 1-based, inclusive).

See also

as_refi()
